titleEn: Delivering Boxes from Storage to Ports
title: 从仓库到码头运输箱子
summary: 箱子须按顺序装船，每趟受箱数和总重量限制；船从仓库出发，按箱子港口顺序停靠并回仓，求最少航程段数。
insight: 一趟运送连续区间 j+1..i 的代价是区间内港口变化数加二。DP 转移可整理为 change[i]+2 加上 dp[j]-change[j+1]，用单调队列在合法窗口中取最小值。
pitfalls: 同一港口连续箱子只需停靠一次
窗口同时受箱数与重量约束
候选 j 的比较值使用 change[j+1]

solutions.title: 窗口 DP 与单调队列
solutions.idea: 把每个合法上一断点的转移常数项维护为单调队列。
steps: 构造重量前缀 weight 与港口变化前缀 change
对 i 移除超过 maxBoxes 或 maxWeight 的队首断点 j
用队首求 dp[i]=dp[j]+change[i]-change[j+1]+2；按 dp[i]-change[i+1] 维护队列递增

code.java: class Solution { public int boxDelivering(int[][] boxes,int portsCount,int maxBoxes,int maxWeight){int n=boxes.length;long[] weight=new long[n+1];int[] change=new int[n+2];for(int i=1;i<=n;i++){weight[i]=weight[i-1]+boxes[i-1][1];change[i]=change[i-1]+(i>1&&boxes[i-1][0]!=boxes[i-2][0]?1:0);}change[n+1]=change[n];int[] dp=new int[n+1];Deque<Integer> deque=new ArrayDeque<>();deque.offerLast(0);for(int i=1;i<=n;i++){while(i-deque.peekFirst()>maxBoxes||weight[i]-weight[deque.peekFirst()]>maxWeight)deque.pollFirst();int j=deque.peekFirst();dp[i]=dp[j]+change[i]-change[j+1]+2;if(i<n){int value=dp[i]-change[i+1];while(!deque.isEmpty()&&dp[deque.peekLast()]-change[deque.peekLast()+1]>=value)deque.pollLast();deque.offerLast(i);}}return dp[n];} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun boxDelivering(boxes:Array<IntArray>,portsCount:Int,maxBoxes:Int,maxWeight:Int):Int{val n=boxes.size;val weight=LongArray(n+1);val change=IntArray(n+2);for(i in 1..n){weight[i]=weight[i-1]+boxes[i-1][1];change[i]=change[i-1]+if(i>1&&boxes[i-1][0]!=boxes[i-2][0])1 else 0};change[n+1]=change[n];val dp=IntArray(n+1);val deque=java.util.ArrayDeque<Int>();deque.addLast(0);for(i in 1..n){while(i-deque.first>maxBoxes||weight[i]-weight[deque.first]>maxWeight)deque.removeFirst();val previous=deque.first;dp[i]=dp[previous]+change[i]-change[previous+1]+2;if(i<n){val value=dp[i]-change[i+1];while(deque.isNotEmpty()&&dp[deque.last]-change[deque.last+1]>=value)deque.removeLast();deque.addLast(i)}};return dp[n]} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int boxDelivering(vector<vector<int>>& boxes,int portsCount,int maxBoxes,int maxWeight){int n=boxes.size();vector<long long> weight(n+1);vector<int> change(n+2),dp(n+1);for(int i=1;i<=n;++i){weight[i]=weight[i-1]+boxes[i-1][1];change[i]=change[i-1]+(i>1&&boxes[i-1][0]!=boxes[i-2][0]);}change[n+1]=change[n];deque<int> candidates{0};for(int i=1;i<=n;++i){while(i-candidates.front()>maxBoxes||weight[i]-weight[candidates.front()]>maxWeight)candidates.pop_front();int previous=candidates.front();dp[i]=dp[previous]+change[i]-change[previous+1]+2;if(i<n){int value=dp[i]-change[i+1];while(!candidates.empty()&&dp[candidates.back()]-change[candidates.back()+1]>=value)candidates.pop_back();candidates.push_back(i);}}return dp[n];} };
